title: Stable solutions to reaction-diffusion elliptic problems
summary: We are concerned with stable solutions to reaction-diffusion elliptic PDEs. We begin with regularity questions, first addressing the classical Laplacian. In joint work with Figalli, Ros-Oton, and Serra, we proved that stable solutions are smooth up to the optimal dimension 9, thereby solving an open problem posed by Brezis in the mid-1990s. We describe this result and also discuss related progress and open problems for the fractional Laplacian -- arising naturally in boundary reaction problems -- , the $p$-Laplacian, and minimal surfaces.
